\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Tangent vectors via transverse Jacobi fields] 1. ch10:10-17↗ prob:jacobi-fermi-transverse

Suppose $P$ is an embedded submanifold of a Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$, and $U$ is a normal neighborhood of $P$ in $M$. Prove that every tangent vector to $U \setminus P$ is the value of a transverse Jacobi field: more precisely, for each $q \in U \setminus P$ and each $w \in T_q M$, there is a $g$-geodesic segment $\gamma : [0,b] \to U$ such that $\gamma (0) \in P$, $\gamma '(0) \perp T_{\gamma (0)} P$, and $\gamma (b) = q$, and a Jacobi field $J$ along $\gamma $ that is transverse to $P$ and satisfies $J(b) = w$. [Hint: Use Problem 10-16.] \end{exercise}
